INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry.
